decisions.decision: Use SMPP push projection into the SDAR shared ClickHouse warehouse.
decisions.details: The supported path is ProviderOpsEnvelope -> SMPP WAL/normalization/core/relation -> target-specific sdar_shared_warehouse projection. Do not duplicate OTLP ingestion in SDAR Telemetry and do not poll the SMPP Query API as the primary data path.

decisions.decision: Implement a target-specific SDAR warehouse row mapper in smpp-telemetry-platform.
decisions.details: The current target manager only remaps table names, while the standalone Core row shape differs from sdar_core.external_provider_fact. A typed transformer is therefore required; tableMap alone is not sufficient.

decisions.decision: SMPP ProviderOps remains source authority; SDAR external tables are immutable analytical projections.
decisions.details: SDAR Telemetry must never mutate provider authority or use external facts for online provider registration/availability decisions.

decisions.decision: Freeze an explicit smppSourceId in Source Mapping v4.
decisions.details: smpp_source_id must be an explicit stable identifier. It must not be derived from URLs, providerId, runtime instance or deployment display names.

decisions.decision: Freeze a per-record-type ProviderOps payload catalog.
decisions.details: The envelope permits arbitrary payload. lifecycle_status, provider_substate, reason_code, revisions, progress and terminal semantics may only be extracted from versioned payload contracts, never by heuristic JSON field search.
No unique sdar_task_id, smpp_task_id, resource owner or provider owner column may be introduced into neutral Core facts. Cross-system bindings belong in external_entity_relation_fact.

decisions.decision: The SMPP SDAR target remains optional until parity qualification succeeds.
decisions.details: Failure of the SDAR shadow target must not block the required standalone SMPP target. Promote the target only after count/hash/watermark/relation parity and restart tests pass.

decisions.decision: Provider terminal is not Goal completion or physical verification.
decisions.details: Provider task/command terminal state can support receipt, execution, recovery and reconciliation evidence, but cannot alone prove SDAR Goal achieved, business outcome, or physical verification.

decisions.decision: SDAR Telemetry owns consumer preflight, readiness, reconciliation and Benchmark handoff.
decisions.details: After data lands in sdar_core external tables, SDAR Telemetry exposes typed read/query contracts and readiness; Benchmark Server consumes those contracts rather than connecting to the SMPP standalone warehouse.

decisions.decision: No ClickHouse DDL is authorized by this increment.
decisions.details: Use the rebuilt 1.5.1-rc.2 tables/views. Any missing/incompatible column or view is a fail-closed schema-delta blocker, not an invitation to patch all.sql inside either telemetry repository.
